source_selection_transparency.presearch_rule_status: No deterministic source-level selection rule or exact 12 identities were frozen before ESearch. The 12 source themes were explored in the recorded order; individual papers and pair assignments were selected after metadata retrieval using publication-window/source completeness, abstract-supported mechanism specificity, pairwise domain separation, and prior-source disjointness. No model/validator/retrieval performance was viewed. This is not represented as a random or unbiased sample.
source_selection_transparency.exact_order_basis: candidate_ledger.fetch_pool_order is the actual order of the 101 PubmedArticle records in the retained EFetch response. The raw per-query ESearch arrays/ranks are unavailable and are not reconstructed.
source_selection_transparency.selected_order: Six cases are fixed in the bank; within each case the positive precedes its distinct control.
source_selection_transparency.source_selection_outcomes: All 101 candidate IDs were disjoint from both prior-source exclusion receipts; one record (PMID 41602105) with 2026-01-12 ArticleDate was not eligible despite PubDate year 2025. PMID 41338731 was selected from the already-fetched fungal biosynthesis candidate block instead. No extra query or screen was run.
source_selection_transparency.second_metadata_batch: Task-recorded B1 used twelve topic searches with 2023:2025[pdat], retmax8. B2 repeated twelve themes with explicit 2023/01/01–2025/12/31 Date-Publication syntax, retmax6; T6SS dropped the mechanism term. The date-syntax purpose is recorded; reasons for retmax/term changes were not retained and are not inferred. Both passes preceded the official abstract batch and any study/model search.
source_selection_transparency.candidate_pool_coverage_limit: The retained task trace records pooling/deduplicating B1+B2 IDs into the sole101-record EFetch. Raw per-query ESearch arrays are absent, so all-query pool coverage cannot be reconstructed independently; official fetched records and selected identities can be independently verified.

prior_source_exclusion_checks.timing: Original source-selection check; task record says before source discovery on 2026-09-30; exact timestamp was not retained in the exclusion receipt.
prior_source_exclusion_checks.scope: Prior target/anchor/returned source PMID fields in novelty artifacts.
Expanded receipt also scans numeric id and raw selected/fetched/returned/first-ID lists; used as the final pre-registration disjointness check.
